name: Product Compare for WooCommerce
author: Jthemes Studio

sections.description:
Product Compare for WooCommerce is a powerful and user-friendly plugin that allows your customers to compare products side by side with ease. Enhance your WooCommerce store by helping users make more informed purchase decisions based on product attributes, price, ratings, and more.

This plugin features a clean, responsive comparison table with extensive customization options. With advanced features in the Pro version, you can offer a truly seamless and smart comparison experience — boosting user satisfaction and sales.

Presentation

Premium | Demo | Documentation

🎥 Watch in Action

Experience Product Compare for WooCommerce in action:

✨ Free Version Features

🛠️ Button & Link Customization

  • 🔧 Set custom Compare Button text
  • ❌ Set custom Remove Button text
  • 💡 Enable automatic lightbox popup for product comparison

📊 Product Data in the Comparison Table

  • 🏷️ Customize the comparison table title
  • 🖼️ Display product image
  • 📝 Display product title
  • 💲 Show product price
  • ⭐ Show product rating
  • 🗒️ Show product description
  • 🔢 Show product SKU
  • ✅ Show availability status
  • ⚖️ Show product weight
  • 📐 Show product dimensions
  • 🛒 Show Add to Cart button
  • 🧩 Show custom product attributes

🔐 Pro Version Features

🚀 Advanced Product Comparison

  • ➕ Add custom product meta to the comparison table
  • 🎨 Use predefined styles for comparison layouts
  • 🔀 Choose between Vertical or Horizontal table layouts

🧠 Smarter Comparison Tools

  • 🙈 Hide similar values across compared products
  • 🎯 Highlight key differences for easy scanning
  • 🔗 Ability to display related product comparison on single product pages

🌟 Enhanced User Experience

  • 🔗 Generate a shareable URL for comparison tables
  • 📌 Ability for sticky compare bar for quick access while browsing

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/product-compare-for-woo/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to JThemes > Product Compare to configure plugin options.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the compare button text?

Yes, both “Compare” and “Remove” button texts can be customized from the plugin settings.

Is it possible to compare custom product attributes?

Yes. If enabled, the plugin supports comparing WooCommerce custom attributes.

What are the advantages of the Pro version?

The Pro version includes advanced table layouts, styling options, difference highlighting, sticky compare bar, shareable links, and more.

Is this plugin compatible with any theme?

Yes, it’s designed to work with most WooCommerce-compatible themes. For theme-specific conflicts, contact support.
